script.problem: It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: “Did not spoil their goodness with sin” could suggest they never sinned. Jamieson-Fausset-Brown says believers are not completely free from sin.
“Unlike most in Sardis” sounds like a claim about everyone in the city. The notes compare these people with others in the church at Sardis.
